item.title: [SwiftHFR] LOT-048: confirm a public new topic and a topic delete from W40/W41/W49 (#396)
item.body:
LOT-048
Closes #396
Claim: cloud/i396

**Problem.** The run-8 captures (#394) settle E14 and the public X1, but the posting tests still stood `W10` (a new MP) in for a public new-topic answer, never read `W41`/`W49`/`R92`, and a `PostingResult` could not tell the app whether a delete took the whole topic, nor where a new topic (whose answer names no topic id) leads.

**Cause.** The engine's confirmation was already right (`W40`/`W41`/`W49` classify `success` with this write's sentence, `HopResponseParserTests`); what was missing was the reading of the refresh target.

**Change.**
- `PostingResult.refreshRoute` (LOT-095 `HFRLinkRoute` of `refreshURL`): `W40` → `.topicList(cat 10, no sub-category)`, the category list, no topic id.
- `PostingResult.deletedWholeTopic`: a delete whose answer refreshes to a topic list (`W19` `forum1.php?cat=prive`, `W49` `/hfr/Programmation/iOS/liste_sujet-1.htm`) is a topic delete; one that refreshes to the topic (`W16a`, `W32`) is not. Computed from HFR's answer, not from the form's signs, so it reports what HFR did. Both are computed properties: `init` and `Equatable` unchanged.
- No guard change: every public delete still requires `confirmingWholeTopic` (spec item 4; trusting the public first-post signs stays a follow-up decision).
- Docs: LOT-048 spec (behaviour 8, tests, pending capture: public new topic and first-post delete now captured; the forms served right before `W40`/`W41`/`W49` are not, so bodies are compared by field names), HFR-PROTOCOL §6c LOT-048 (delete scope read from the answer), `PostingAction.confirmation` doc.
- `W41` (poll added by the first-post edit form): the engine sends the poll fields as served; filling them is LOT-054's.

Overlap: #407 also edits the LOT-048 spec (step 1); different paragraph.

**Tests** (`PostingTopicCaptureTests`, new; Swift Testing):
- `newTopic`: `R45a` + signature box → body field names equal `W40`'s `request_fields` in order; `W40` confirmed, refresh `/hfr/Programmation/liste_sujet-1.htm`, no anchor, no post number, route = category 10 list, not a topic delete.
- `firstPostEditWithPollFields`: edit from `R63b` → names (boxes aside) equal `W41`'s, no `delete`; confirmed, anchor `t9910000001`.
- `firstPostDeleteDeletesTopic`: `R63b` delete without `confirmingWholeTopic` → `wholeTopicDeletionNotConfirmed`, no POST; with it → `delete=1`, names equal `W49`'s, confirmed, route = `iOS` sub-category list of cat 10, `deletedWholeTopic`.
- `deleteAnswerTellsTopicDelete`: `W19`, `W49` true; `W16a`, `W32` false.
- `listRefreshOfOtherWrites`: `W40` (new topic) and `W10` (new MP) refresh to lists but are not topic deletes.
- `deletedTopicPage`: `R92` served 404 → `network(.httpStatus(404))`, one GET, no token recorded.
- `PostingCaptureTests.newTopic` now uses `W40` instead of `W10`.
- Shown to fail: without the `action == .delete` guard, 3 expectations fail (W40, W10); with `deletedWholeTopic` always false, W19/W49 fail.

`swift test` (Linux): 1280 tests pass. SwiftLint clean on the touched files.

+import Foundation
+import HFRModels
+import HFRNetwork
+import HFRParsing
+import Testing
+@testable import HFRClient
+
+/// Public topic writes captured in run 8 (#396): a new topic (`W40`), a first-post edit adding a poll (`W41`) and the
+/// first-post delete that removed the topic (`W49`, then `R92`). Their forms were not captured as served, so the closest
+/// captured forms stand in (`R45a` new topic, `R63b` first-post edit of another own topic); the bodies are compared by
+/// field names in order, the answers are HFR's own bytes.
+@Suite("Posting flow: public new topic and topic delete")
+struct PostingTopicCaptureTests {
+    /// Boxes the captures sent with legacy semantics (`"0"` when unchecked): a browser sends only the checked ones.
+    private static let boxes: Set<String> = ["have_sondage", "allowvisitor", "signature", "smiley", "emaill", "delete"]
+    private static let editURL = "https://forum.hardware.fr/bdd.php?config=hfr.inc"
+
+    /// A write that must not run: the form load fails first.
+    private static let noWrite: PostingHarness.Write = { _, _ async throws(PostingError) -> PostingResult in
+        Issue.record("no form expected")
+        throw .missingAction
+    }
+
+    private func names(_ body: String?, droppingBoxes: Bool = false) -> [String] {
+        PostingHarness.pairs(of: body ?? "").map(\.name).filter { !droppingBoxes || !Self.boxes.contains($0) }
+    }
+
+    private func capturedNames(_ id: String) throws -> [String] {
+        try #require(try Capture.meta(id).requestFields).filter { !Self.boxes.contains($0) }
+    }
+
+    @Test("W40: a new topic is confirmed; HFR refreshes to the category list and names no topic id")
+    func newTopic() async throws {
+        let outcome = try await PostingHarness.run(form: "R45a", answer: "W40") { flow, form async throws(PostingError) in
+            try await flow.newTopic(subject: "fixture-test", text: "text", options: [.signature: true], with: form)
+        }
+        // Same composer layout as W40's (sent from Programmation › iOS with the signature box checked): same fields in order.
+        #expect(names(outcome.body) == (try #require(try Capture.meta("W40").requestFields)))
+        let result = try outcome.result.get()
+        #expect(result.action == .newTopic)
+        #expect(result.message == "Votre message a été posté avec succès !")
+        #expect(result.refreshURL.absoluteString == "https://forum.hardware.fr/hfr/Programmation/liste_sujet-1.htm")
+        #expect(result.refreshAnchor == nil)
+        #expect(result.postNumber == nil)
+        // W40 posted `cat=10`: the list HFR refreshes to is that category's, without a sub-category.
+        let list = HFRTopicListLink(category: .forum(10), subcategory: nil, page: 1, filter: .all)
+        #expect(result.refreshRoute == .topicList(list))
+        #expect(!result.deletedWholeTopic)
+    }
+
+    @Test("W41: a first-post edit from R63b sends the poll fields as served and is confirmed")
+    func firstPostEditWithPollFields() async throws {
+        let outcome = try await PostingHarness.run(form: "R63b", answer: "W41") { flow, form async throws(PostingError) in
+            try await flow.edit("Text removed.", with: form)
+        }
+        let post = try #require(outcome.post)
+        #expect(post.url.absoluteString == Self.editURL)
+        #expect(post.redirectPolicy == .doNotFollow)
+        #expect(names(outcome.body, droppingBoxes: true) == (try capturedNames("W41")))
+        #expect(!names(outcome.body).contains("delete"))
+        let result = try outcome.result.get()
+        #expect(result.action == .edit)
+        #expect(result.message == "Votre message a été édité avec succès !")
+        #expect(result.refreshAnchor == "t9910000001")
+        #expect(result.postNumber == 9_910_000_001)
+        #expect(!result.deletedWholeTopic)
+    }
